public_inputs.name: DirectToLds
public_inputs.note: YAML/MsgPack solution parameter. Integer 0-3: 0=no DTL, 1=both A+B, 2=A only, 3=B only. Default 0 (GlobalParameters.py:461). Drives kernel[DirectToLdsA]=(DirectToLds==1 or DirectToLds==2) and kernel[DirectToLdsB]=(DirectToLds==1 or DirectToLds==3) via Solution.py:722-723.

derived_symbols.name: tc
derived_symbols.derivation: KernelWriterAssembly.py:10885 -- tc = tP[tensorChar]. tensorChar is the literal string cM (A or B) assigned in KernelWriter.getTensorParameters (KernelWriter.py:9110). cM is the constant string passed at each getTensorParameters call: A for tensorParametersA, B for tensorParametersB (KernelWriter.py:6567-6568). tc is a compile-time constant relative to the call-site.

derived_symbols.name: kernel[DirectToLdsA]
derived_symbols.derivation: Solution.py:722 -- state[DirectToLdsA] = state[DirectToLds] == 1 or state[DirectToLds] == 2. Forced False when BufferLoad=False or KernelLanguage!=Assembly (Solution.py:1830-1832). May also be reset if isDirectToLdsDoable() fails (Solution.py:3923-3926).

derived_symbols.name: kernel[DirectToLdsB]
derived_symbols.derivation: Solution.py:723 -- state[DirectToLdsB] = state[DirectToLds] == 1 or state[DirectToLds] == 3. Same conditional reset logic as DirectToLdsA.
